audio.description: Play a sound when a bell rings in any terminal, focused or not.

sound.description:
The sound the audible bell plays: the macOS alert sound or a named
system sound.

volume.description:
How loud a named sound plays, from 0 to 1; the system alert sound
follows the macOS alert volume instead.

BellSound.description: A sound the audible bell plays.

oneOf.description:
The alert sound chosen in macOS's Sound settings, at its alert
volume.

ClipboardWritePolicy.description: Permission for clipboard writes requested by terminal content.

oneOf.description: Allow terminal content to replace the system clipboard.
Drop terminal-content clipboard writes.

LinkModifiers.description: The modifiers to hold when clicking a link, joined with hyphens. Defaults to `cmd` on macOS, which does not allow `ctrl`, and `ctrl` on Linux.

NewTabDirectory.description: Where new tabs and panes start.

oneOf.description: Use a usable local directory reported by the active terminal.
Always use Huterm's platform launch default.

placement.description: Where the palette sits within the window: `top` or `center`.

retain_query.description:
Keep the search text when the palette is cancelled, and restore it if
the palette reopens soon after.

retain_query_seconds.description:
How long a cancelled palette keeps its search text, in seconds, from 0
to 3600.

PalettePlacement.description: Where the command palette sits within its window.

oneOf.description: Anchored near the top edge of the window.
Centred at full height, so filtering never moves the input.

PaneTitleBarMode.description: Whether a split tab's panes show their title bars.

oneOf.description: Each pane shows its title bar, which takes space from its terminal.

A pane's title bar takes no space and fades in over its terminal
while the pointer rests where it would be.
No pane shows a title bar; close, zoom, and move remain commands.

PaneTitleBarPosition.description: Which edge of a pane its title bar runs along.

oneOf.description: Along the pane's top edge.
Along the pane's bottom edge.
Each window zooms panes on its own.
The tab owns the zoom, which every window set to `shared` shows.

drag_modifier.description:
Hold these modifiers to drag a pane from anywhere inside it. Defaults to
`cmd-ctrl` on macOS and `ctrl-alt` on Linux; `off` turns it off.

focus_accent.description:
How strongly an accent line marks the focused pane under `hover` or
`hidden` title bars, from 0 (off) to 1 (100%).

inactive_dim.description: How much the panes without focus dim, from 0 (off) to 0.8 (80%).

layout_cycle.description:
The layouts Next and Previous Pane Layout step through, in order:
`columns`, `rows`, `main_left`, `main_top`, `main_centered`, `tiled`,
or a name from `[panes.layouts]`.

additionalProperties.description: A layout template, such as `columns(pane 60%, rows(*))`.

layouts.description:
Your own pane layouts, each a template such as `columns(pane 60%,
rows(*))`: `columns` and `rows` place their children across or down,
`pane` takes one pane, `*` the rest, and `grid(*)` tiles them.

Names are lowercase letters, digits, and underscores, start with a
letter, and cannot be a built-in layout's name.

title_bar.description:
How a split tab's panes show title bars: `visible` bars take space,
`hover` bars fade in over the terminal when the pointer rests at their
edge, and `hidden` bars never show.

title_bar_fade_ms.description:
How long a `hover` title bar takes to fade in or out, in milliseconds,
from 0 to 1000.

title_bar_hide_delay_ms.description:
How long a `hover` title bar stays after the pointer leaves, in
milliseconds, from 0 to 5000.

title_bar_hover_delay_ms.description:
How long the pointer rests at a pane's edge before its `hover` title bar
appears, in milliseconds, from 0 to 2000.

title_bar_position.description:
The pane edge the title bar and focus accent run along: `top` or
`bottom`.

zoom.description:
Each window zooms panes on its own (`view`), or the tab's zoom shows in
every window set to `shared`.

animation.description:
How the window shows and hides. Auto fades fullscreen windows and slides
others in.

animation_ms.description: How long it animates, in milliseconds, from 0 to 1000.

display.description:
The display the window opens on: the active one, the one under the
pointer, the primary one, or `id:` and a display identifier.

fullscreen.description: Covers the whole display frame instead of a part of its work area.

height.description:
The fraction of the display's work area it takes, above 0 and at
most 1.

hide_on_focus_loss.description: Hides the window when another application takes focus.

position.description:
The display edge the window sits against, or Center. Fullscreen uses it
only for Slide.

width.description:
The fraction of the display's work area it takes, above 0 and at
most 1.

family.description:
The terminal font family. Defaults to Menlo on macOS and `monospace` on
Linux.

ui_family.description:
The font of Huterm's tabs, title bars, menus, dialogs, and Settings.
Empty uses the system font.

ui_size.description:
The interface text size in points, from 10 to 16. At 13 the interface
draws at its design size.

clipboard_write.description:
Whether programs in the terminal may replace the system clipboard. Copy
and Paste always work.

close_on_exit.x-huterm-label: Close a pane when its shell exits

engine.description:
Deprecated compatibility setting. Both legacy values use Ghostty;
remove this field.

new_tab_directory.x-huterm-label: New tabs and panes start in

right_click.description:
What a right-click on the terminal does. While a program takes the
mouse, Shift-right-click does it.

scrollback_bytes.description:
An optional size limit on each terminal's screen and history, such as
`64MiB` or `50MB`, up to `16GiB`; `0` keeps no history. Whichever limit
is reached first applies.

scrollback_compression.description:
Compress idle history to about a tenth of its memory. The first width
change afterwards takes longer.

scrollback_rows.description:
Live history each terminal keeps above its screen, in rows, from 0 to
100000; 0 keeps none.

oneOf.description: Once per display frame.
As soon as the last frame finishes.

RightClickAction.description:
What a right-click on the terminal does when no application has taken
the mouse, or with Shift held when one has.

oneOf.description: Open the terminal's context menu at the pointer.
Paste the clipboard.
Copy and clear the selection, or paste when nothing is selected.
Do nothing.

dark.description: The theme while the system is in dark mode; setting `light` or `dark` follows the system, and an unset one uses `name`.

light.description: The theme while the system is in light mode; setting `light` or `dark` follows the system, and an unset one uses `name`.

name.description: The theme to use, bundled or your own; `light` and `dark` replace it in their mode.

show_advanced.description: Show the settings marked Advanced in every section.

SizeIndicator.description: How the window shows its grid size while it resizes.

oneOf.description: The size panel, or the compact badge where the panel does not fit.
The compact badge alone.
No indicator.
Only while the pointer is over the tab.
On the active tab, and on any hovered tab.
On every tab.

TabDirectory.description: How tab labels show a directory. The local home directory is always `~`.

oneOf.description: The last path component, such as `huterm`.

The full path, relative to home when under it, such as
`~/Projects/huterm`.

The path with parent components shortened to their first character,
such as `~/P/huterm`.

TabLabel.description:
What automatic tab labels show. Smart shows a running program's title or
name, and the directory at an idle shell; a tab's own name always wins.

oneOf.description:
A running program's own title, else its name; at an idle shell, the
directory.
The title set by the shell or program.
The foreground program's name.
The current directory.
The foreground program's name and the current directory.

TabNotch.description:
Where a top tab bar goes on a notched display in non-native fullscreen:
below the notch, or beside it on one side.

oneOf.description: Tabs share the title bar. Without one, they take a top bar.

always_show.x-huterm-label: Show the tab bar with one tab

close_button.description: When a tab shows its close button; hovering a tab always shows it.

notch.description: Put a top bar beside a display notch in non-native fullscreen.

pill_accent.description: Draws the accent bar inside the active pill; ignored by other styles.
pill_accent.x-huterm-label: Accent bar in the active pill

position.description:
Where tabs sit: top, bottom, left, right, or titlebar. Defaults to
titlebar on macOS and top on Linux.

TerminalIdentity.description: Terminal identity advertised to local applications.

oneOf.description:
Use `xterm-huterm` when its terminfo entry is available locally. SSH
hosts without the entry can garble line editing.
Advertise Huterm's private terminfo entry.
Use the widely installed compatibility entry.

UpdateConfig.description: Overrides for the updater. Unset fields keep Sparkle's stored preferences.

automatic_checks.description:
Turn scheduled update checks on or off. Unset keeps Sparkle's stored
choice.

check_interval_hours.description:
Hours between scheduled update checks, at least 1. Unset keeps Sparkle's
interval, 24 on a fresh profile.

macos_native_menus.description:
Open Huterm's menus as native macOS menus. Off draws them in Huterm's
style.

menu_button.description:
Show the window menu button in the title bar, or in the tab bar without
one.

shortcut_hints.description: Show key hints on the scroll pill and on dialog and panel buttons.

size_indicator.description:
The `columns × rows` indicator while a window or pane resizes: the
`full` panel, the `compact` badge, or `off`.

size_indicator_linger_ms.description:
How long the size indicator stays after resizing stops, in milliseconds,
from 0 to 10000.

theme.description:
The color theme, or one for each of the system's light and dark
modes with `light` and `dark`.

themes.description:
Named themes that `[theme]` can select, each starting from another
theme with `extends`.
